messages.subject: Stan talk on 8/20 in NYC
parts:
if you're in NYC, I'm giving a Stan talk at the NYC Machine Learning meetup:
http://www.meetup.com/NYC-Machine-Learning/events/224631932/

Cross listed at the Stan Users NYC meetup:
http://www.meetup.com/Stan-Users-NYC/events/224466087/

Daniel
